question: whether the completion time of the 24-iteration b1 shape varies near the 300 s platform limit through request cost, service variation, or neither
authorization: none: the six jobs wait for the owner's approval of the written case
quantity: the provider-reported duration of each job, in seconds; wall time from submission to collection is recorded beside it and not analyzed
stop_conditions: a job ends canceled or failed, or reports a duration at the 300 s limit
a job is submitted before the previous job is collected, or while the token holds a running or queued job
a job body carries a mitigation, or the service reports another platform
spent credits plus one job's authorization of 1.08 exceed 6.48
the sum of reported durations reaches 1800 s before the next submission

decision.spread: s(P) = (max - min) / mean of the three durations of request P
decision.means: |m1 - m2| / mean(m1, m2) of the replicate means
decision.deviation: a duration above 150 s or below 135 s departs from the prediction and is recorded before any rule is applied

recorder: scripts/bdsc_diagnostic_timing_case.py record reads the job status on a fixed 10 s cadence into status-log.jsonl; a read that takes longer than the cadence delays the next read, and the log carries each read's own time
